sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Mayor Zohran Mamdani unveiled a plan on Friday to close the Rikers Island jail complex by 2032. The proposal includes building four new jails in Brooklyn, the Bronx, Queens and Manhattan, and reducing the detainee population from over 6,500 to 4,100. Previous closure plans faced delays under former Mayor Eric Adams' administration and due to the Covid pandemic. The City Council must approve the updated timeline.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Rikers Island has faced severe backlash over staffing shortages, crumbling conditions and nine inmate deaths this year. Supporters describe the closure as a generational opportunity to transform detention and improve inmate outcomes. However, the New York City correction officers' union criticized the plan, arguing that an arbitrary cap on jail beds jeopardises public safety by potentially releasing violent felons.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: The Federal Communications Commission voted to allow state and local prisons and jails to use targeted jamming technology against contraband cellphones. gist: A truck killed three people at a Tsawwassen First Nation ceremony near Vancouver.
Police initially suggested a medical emergency, causing outrage as no driver was arrested.
Community members are gathering their own evidence due to a lack of answers.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: A black pickup truck towing an equipment trailer breached a curb outside a mall near Vancouver, striking a group gathered for a Tsawwassen First Nation ceremony. Virginia Splockton and wilapiya were killed at the scene, and Gwenyth Brigid Dwyn died later in hospital. Minutes earlier, the same truck had struck another vehicle nearby. Police released the driver from the hospital the same day without charges, suggesting a preliminary medical emergency.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Families and community members are outraged by the lack of arrests and communication from Delta police. They argue officers rushed to conclusions about a medical emergency, leaving grieving families to gather their own evidence and video footage.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Police stated they are still investigating the movements of the vehicle and the possibility of a medical event, adding that charges would be laid if evidence establishes criminality.
